notes:
Early inbound from a B2B SaaS startup (SilkStreet Assistly) building an in-app chat assistant inside their CRM product. Self-serve signup, then reached out for help getting low-latency streaming.
- Primary contacts: Liam Park (founder, liam@silkstreet.ai), Maya Lopez (CTO, maya@silkstreet.ai).
- Technical ask: streaming token-level output with user-visible typing; target client-side perceived latency <150ms per token ideally, backend TTF ~80-120ms in NA; initial concurrency small (5-10 qps) ramping to ~50 qps over 6 months.
- Model preference: small/optimized open models (fast, quantized) - willing to test Redwood-verified model profiles.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage; wants predictable per-seat / per-active-user buckets; will evaluate hosted API first, Dedicated later if traffic warrants.
- Security: needs SOC2 attestation for sales conversations, SSO for internal team, audit logs for later enterprise deals. Not mandatory to start POC but a blocker for some prospects.
- Quote from founder on discovery call: "Need smooth streaming in-app — no stutter; users notice pauses and drop off."
- POC plan: 2-week focused test (EU + NA regions) to validate TTF, streaming jitter, and basic fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.
- Action items: send streaming quickstart repo, sample frontend showing token streaming, provide a short pricing cheat-sheet for low-volume startups.
- Links: drive pricing deck, Fireflies transcript (ff_20260301_001), Gmail thread-12kJ9.
- Sales guidance: SMB motion, try to keep friction low (self-serve credits + guided docs). If POC successful, propose a 6-12 month committed plan (Dedicated evaluation at ~200k monthly tokens).
